info.title: zplcore-mcp – MCP server (stdio) for zplCore.com
info.description: MCP server (Model Context Protocol, stdio only) for zplCore.com: lets coding agents render, lint, format, diff and fill ZPL/EPL labels. Sandboxed: no file system, network, shell or environment access; every call runs in a resource-limited worker process.

options.name: --no-os-sandbox
options.description: macOS: do not run workers under sandbox-exec (no network, no file writes)

options.name: --log
options.description: stderr logging (default info; tool input is never logged)

options.name: --license
options.description:
zplCore licence key, or a file that contains it (else ZPLCORE_LICENSE,
ZPLCORE_LICENSE_FILE or zplcore.license next to the server); checked offline
